lesson.pause.intent: Stop the lesson, demonstration and sound; an adult confirms before resuming.
lesson.pause.constraint: Do not imply ending, losing work or advancing.

lesson.moreTime.intent: Hold this stage until Continue lesson is chosen, with no time limit.
lesson.moreTime.constraint: Do not imply buying time, a fixed extra interval or stopping music.

lesson.replayInstruction.constraint: Distinguish listening from showing the drawing movement.

lesson.replayDemonstration.intent: Show this drawing movement again, preserving earlier stages.
lesson.replayDemonstration.constraint: Do not imply restarting the whole lesson or erasing paper.

help.playHint.intent: Play the requested explanation while music continues softly.
help.playHint.constraint: Refer to listening to help, not revealing an answer or grading.

help.stopHint.intent: Stop the spoken hint; the help dialog remains open.
help.stopHint.constraint: Do not imply closing Help, stopping music or ending the lesson.

setup.stopVoicePreview.intent: Stop the greeting preview before the lesson begins.
setup.stopVoicePreview.constraint: This does not disable narration or start the lesson. Can differ from the settings control.

settings.stopVoicePreview.intent: Stop the voice sample played from parent settings.
settings.stopVoicePreview.constraint: This does not disable narration. Can differ from the pre-lesson greeting control.
